text:
Noah: Postmortem follow-up thread: capturing owners for the GPU capacity/autoscale action items. Short-term fixes + longer-term guardrails.
Ivy: I'll take the scheduler tuning. Immediate tasks: reduce aggressive scale-down, add stabilization, and evaluate pod packing thresholds. Plan a staging canary then promote.
Diego: I'll handle quota coordination with cloud partner and finance. Need a temporary bump for the weekend test and a commit PR for steady-state reserve.
Rena: I'll own runbook updates and the oncall playbook edits (including quick-reserve steps and model-fallback routing). Will add example commands.
Ivy: Proposed HPA change for staging:
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
behavior:
  scaleDown:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 420
metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70
```
Ivy: This should avoid thrash when embeddings jobs finish quickly.
Noah: Can we gate large nightly batch embeddings? If so, is that a scheduler policy or a job owner change?
Diego: Prefer marking jobs with "schedule: off-peak" label. I'll ask jobs team for a short-term rollout. If they can't, I'll request a temporary quota bump to protect customers.
Rena: Observability ask: add a headroom_gpus metric per pool and a 10-min rolling alert when headroom < 12% for 3 windows. Also a dashboard tile for reserved_vs_free.
Ivy: I'll add the metric and alert. Target deploy: 2026-04-04 for metric, 2026-04-05 for alert wiring.
Noah: Owners/timelines recap: Ivy - scheduler canary & metrics (canary 2026-03-31, promote 2026-04-03), Diego - temp quota bump (2026-03-29) and reserve PR (2026-04-08), Rena - runbook + playbook (2026-03-28).
Diego: capacity-bot created ticket https://redwood.local/tickets/INC-4502 for temp bump and TASK-9301 for scheduler canary.
capacity-bot: Reminder: INC-4502 created by Diego; status: awaiting finance approval. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Rena: I'll include two recurring incident examples in the runbook: midnight embeddings surge and cold-start latency when spinning new model workers.
Noah: Also schedule a 48h weekend simulation to validate preemption and headroom behavior. Who can coordinate?
Ivy: I'll run the simulation on weekend 2026-04-04. Need capacity oncall + jobs team present.
Rena: I'll create a post-sim report template to capture any gaps.
Noah: If quota approval is delayed, we fallback to rerouting non-critical traffic to a smaller model for up to 72h. Diego, include that in the ticket notes.
Diego: Will add fallback traffic-routing plan.
Ivy: Small follow-up: add a canary on lowest-traffic org for 24h before full rollout.
Noah: Good. I'll set a 15m closure check for 2026-04-06 to confirm status.
capacity-bot: Action tracker updated: INC-4502, TASK-9301, TASK-9302 (runbook), TASK-9303 (sim).
Rena: I'll start the weekly 10m remediation check-ins next Wednesday.
Noah: Thanks all. Please put blockers here. Otherwise :thumbsup: and I'll mark these closed in the action tracker after the 04/06 check.
